attempt: Built the unmodified sources as the driver header says (SSRFTEST links to STRIPACK and SSRFPACK; the archive ships no build file, so the compile lines are ours). No source file was edited. The run writes RES in an empty directory holding a copy of Drivers/Sp/data. Line 562 (FF(16,16)) per pass, against the shipped 0.44416130E+00 and tol_abs 1e-6: pass 1 gfortran 16.2 -O2 = 0.44415909 (miss, 2.21e-6); pass 2 same -O2 repeated = 0.44415909 (agrees); pass 3 gfortran 16.2 -O0 = 0.44416130 (hit); pass 4 gfortran 13 -O2 = 0.44416130 (hit). Probe (evidence/probe-flags.txt): gfortran 16.2 -O1 and -O0 hit; -O2 -fno-tree-vectorize hits; -O2 -ffloat-store and -O2 -ffp-contract=off still miss. So the miss depends on the toolchain, not on the sources: it is gfortran 16.2 -O2 with vectorisation (diagnosed by flag toggling, not by reading the loop). The registered 1e-6 is about 0.45 of the 2.2e-6 spread between toolchains, which is larger than the single-precision noise the scout's tolerance basis assumed. Verdict blocked, not reproduced: the claim as registered does not decide the verdict. See note-to-scout.md. The claim and tolerance are unchanged.

original_attempt.reason: the unmodified sources built with the compile lines in the driver header and ran to completion (build_exit=0, run_exit=0) in all three passes; the compile flags are ours because the archive ships no build file, which is why the verdict is partial rather than reproduced
